research_rationale: Identity: the registered original is the Federal Register printing of Executive Order 12376 (47 FR 34349, Federal Register of August 9, 1982; govinfo PDF text layer), signed August 5, 1982 and headed Presidential Commission on Drunk Driving. I read the whole held text: it is a single operative paragraph that amends the second sentence of Section 1 of Executive Order No. 12358 of April 14, 1982 so that the Commission is composed of no more than 28 members (the parent's held Federal Register text provides for no more than 26). Inventory: one clause, the sole paragraph, which matches the dossier inventory; the order has no numbered sections, no termination clause and no effective-date clause. Ending: the amended sentence is part of Section 1 of the parent, and under the owner ruling of 2026-10-21 on strike-and-insert amendments the amended clause continues, as amended, until the parent order ends. The parent's section 4(b), as originally issued, terminated the Commission one year after April 14, 1982. Executive Order 12415 of April 5, 1983 (48 FR 15117, Federal Register of April 7, 1983; held printing) amended section 4(b) of Executive Order No. 12358, as amended, so that the Commission terminates on December 31, 1983. That provision governs the very Commission whose membership ceiling this order set, so it is the order's own-terms end through the parent, and it is a different proposition from a later general rule: after the Commission terminated there were no members to count and nothing for the ceiling to govern. The first end is recorded as 1983-12-31, taking the stated date inclusively (the Commission runs through that day); the exclusive reading, under which the Commission ends when that day begins, is the alternative and moves the end by one day, to the instant before 1983-12-31 begins. Executive Order 12415 does not name Executive Order 12376 and is not a revocation of it; it is cited as the instrument that fixed the parent's termination date, and the earlier-end analysis below states why it ends this clause. A search of the held order texts for the number 12358 found only the parent's own printing, this order, Executive Order 12415, the Executive Order 12553 table and the Peano formulary notes (which record that this order amends 12358 and that 12553 revoked it); no held text extends or revives the Commission after December 31, 1983. Formal disposition: Executive Order 12553 of February 25, 1986 (51 FR 7237, Federal Register of March 3, 1986) revokes the orders listed in its table, and any amendments thereto, and the table lists 12376 (together with 12358 and 12415). That revocation came more than two years after the Commission had terminated, so it is the formal disposition and not the first end; it is recorded as a later event. Its enacting provision states no effective date, so its signing date is used. Searches: the U.S. Code and eCFR citation searches and the OFR executive-order catalog search were selected after reading their coverage notes (all complete, no coverage warning; the U.S. Code edition runs through 2026-10-09 and the eCFR search to 2026-10-14, which cannot matter for an order whose end is in 1983). The catalog search returned two hits, Executive Order 12415 and Executive Order 12553, both reconciled here.
savings_reason: No savings clause appears in the order, in Executive Order 12415 or in Executive Order 12553 as to this order. The order only raised the membership ceiling of a Commission that terminated on December 31, 1983, so no surviving appointment, transfer or right is shown, and a bounded search of the held texts and the OFR catalog shows no continuing independent effect.
earlier_end_check: Candidate earlier ends examined. (1) Section 4(b) of the parent as originally issued (termination one year from April 14, 1982) was replaced by Executive Order 12415 before it operated, so it is not an end. (2) The Commission's termination on December 31, 1983 under section 4(b) as amended by Executive Order 12415 is the earliest end shown by held text; no held instrument extends it, and nothing held shows an end before that date. (3) Executive Order 12553 (1986-02-25) is later and is the formal revocation only. The Peano formulary note and the Federal Register catalog note that Executive Order 12553 revoked this order were reconciled as the formal disposition; they do not move the first end.
scope_check: Scope: the single paragraph of the held text was compared with the dossier clause (characters 690 to 1120 of the registered text) and nothing else in the order is operative. The order amends only the second sentence of section 1 of the parent; it does not amend section 4(b) and does not itself state a duration.
independent_command_check: Independent commands: the order contains one command, the raised membership ceiling, which exists only as part of the parent's section 1 and has no operation apart from the Commission. It is not an independent continuing command.
savings_check: Savings: neither Executive Order 12415 nor Executive Order 12553 contains a savings clause as to this order. The ceiling affected only the Commission's size while it existed; no surviving appointment, transfer or right is shown, and the bounded search of the held 12553 text, this order's text and the OFR catalog shows no residual or continuing independent effect.
